video_title: LeBron Leaving LA | Carmelo Anthony Debates His Final Move

quotes.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential departure from the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James, after eight years in Los Angeles, is saying he's leaving the Lakers.
quotes.quote: LeBron James, after eight years in Los Angeles, is saying he's leaving the Lakers, but he wants to play for another organization. There's been so much talk about it. There's been talk about him possibly playing for a minimum. Money's not an issue, happiness is where he wants to be. All these reports coming out about LeBron's next team.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' move to the Lakers was a lifestyle decision
quotes.excerpt: People thought he was leaving Cleveland to go to LA as a lifestyle decision.
quotes.quote: The crazy thing was when he first got there, I don't think the perception was that he was going there to win. People thought he was leaving Cleveland to go to LA as a lifestyle decision. Going to Hollywood, set up his post-career, whatever it was. The Lakers, it had been a long time since they were relevant when he showed up.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James elevates the profile of the organizations he joins
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James, you can say whatever you want to say about him, he elevates the organizations.
quotes.quote: LeBron James, you can say whatever you want to say about him, he elevates the organizations that he's in. Miami was a destination in theory before he got there. Now, they got Giannis. Before that, they got Jimmy. He elevates the profile of the places that he leaves.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant's legacy and LeBron James' challenge in Los Angeles
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James was not going to win with the fans. It was an impossible situation.
quotes.quote: Kobe Bryant became like this, you know how you have your parents and your grandparents, your grandparents become everything great. Kobe Bryant wouldn't have liked that. LeBron James was not going to win with the fans. It was an impossible situation, but I give it to him for taking it on the chin and even embracing the challenge.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers' efforts to support LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: They brought in Anthony Davis. You got a ring. They drafted his son.
quotes.quote: They brought in Anthony Davis. You got a ring. They drafted his son. They gave him a guaranteed contract. They brought in D'Angelo Russell. That didn't work out so well. So when you say did they do enough for him, the question I ask is what more should they have done for him in this spot?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James' focus on happiness at 42
quotes.excerpt: It's happiness. I got to be at peace with this decision at this point in my life.
quotes.quote: The man is 42 years old. So when you talk about what's being taken into consideration, fuck the money, fuck the ring, it's happiness. I got to be at peace with this decision at this point in my life. My kids, my family, this is what it really comes down to. Fuck the basketball shit.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' priority is winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: Where can I go to win a championship? That's it.
quotes.quote: And then when he starts thinking basketball, then it's like, okay, now if this is going to be it, where can I go to win a championship? That's it. I'm not trying to go to an organization and help develop nobody. I'm not trying to, I'm going where we all ready to rock, we all respect each other, we all know what's on at the stake, and let's go.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' deliberate approach to free agency
quotes.excerpt: There's no rush for him. And I think he earned that. He deserves that.
quotes.quote: There's a lot of movement that's going on out there, and if you notice, any free agency or anytime he came up in trades, it's he, everything was already done already. Unless he really wanted something and he went and got it. Right now, he's just going through it, like, figuring it out. There's no rush for him. And I think he earned that. He deserves that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the physical toll of playing at 42
quotes.excerpt: I wake up and I'm like, man, this shit hurt. I can't imagine what it's like for him.
quotes.quote: I'm three weeks older than LeBron James. I wake up and I'm like, man, this shit hurt. I can't imagine what it's like for him with the wear and tear on the body and everything. So when it's about, when you say it's about him winning the championship or whatever, I don't think that winning another championship does anything different for him than where he's at now.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony advises LeBron James to prioritize fun
quotes.excerpt: Play where it's most fun for you at this stage of your career.
quotes.quote: Play where it's most fun for you at this stage of your career, where you don't got to be the coach, you don't got to be the GM, you don't got to build team culture or whatever it is. I don't know how much championship winning he can do because it's so hard. But go play a place where you going to play for, where you going to play with some fun.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James' decision to join the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: After Kobe's passing, for him to bring a championship, it made him signing with the Lakers make sense.
quotes.quote: After Kobe's passing, for him to bring a championship, it made him signing with the Lakers make sense. Like, okay, this is what we are about. One guy is gone, we bringing somebody else in here who can carry the legacy of that brother, who can carry the legacy of the greats that come through. The Laker organization is all about greatness, the greats. That's it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony's suggested destinations for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Golden State, San Antonio could be an option. Cleveland could be an option.
quotes.quote: For what's been said out there, Golden State, San Antonio could be an option. Cleveland could be an option. Those are the only options that I think he should look at.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero wants LeBron James back in Miami
quotes.excerpt: I want him back in Miami, because I want Knicks-Heat in a playoff series.
quotes.quote: I want him back in Miami, because I want Knicks-Heat in a playoff series like his 97. You try to take, what you trying to do? I see what you trying to do.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James' ideal final season
quotes.excerpt: If he really wants to go somewhere where he doesn't have to establish a culture.
quotes.quote: If he really wants to go somewhere where he doesn't have to establish a culture, doesn't have to be a GM, doesn't have to be a coach. Your GM is your old agent. Your coach is someone that's coached you before. You're going somewhere where you don't got to be the man. You have a championship opportunity. And you're willing to take a minimum, and hell, you still want your bread that bad, you're in New York City.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James and Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see him and Steph just go. They've been wanting to do it.
quotes.quote: I would love to see him and Steph just go. They've been wanting to do it for a while. They've been on the Olympic team. Just go out there, you guys ride this shit out, finish it together. I don't know if Steph, this is it for Steph. I'm just saying like you guys are now at that point where you can actually go and try to develop something throughout the course of the year to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero on LeBron James' impact on the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: You think LeBron is going to come in there with what they got and build them up?
quotes.quote: Game 1, Knicks against Cleveland. It's the fourth quarter and the Knicks are down 22. Probably the Knicks score maybe two buckets in a row and I was like, they going to fold. So you think LeBron is going to come in there with what they got and build them up and make them not fold?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James' fit with the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I feel like LeBron would be a great addition to any team he goes to.
quotes.quote: I feel like LeBron would be a great addition to any team he goes to. Absolutely. I feel like what Cleveland needs is not something that LeBron is going to be. Like when you need a physical toughness, somebody that's going to be rough and tumble and going to be banging with Josh Hart and with Jarrett Allen and before, Miss Robinson, whoever they get, and that physical toughness, you can't be asking LeBron at 42 years old to do that type of dirty work.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James' commitment to winning
quotes.excerpt: If I'm going back to Cleveland, this means I'm giving my all.
quotes.quote: If I'm going back to Cleveland, this means I'm giving my all. We already see what he does every season, and we keep being amazed by the shit. He go back to Cleveland and he got a chance to really win the fucking championship, he's going to give everything, 23 years of the 40 years of basketball into one season, and he instantly elevates the Cleveland Cavaliers.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James' role as a role player
quotes.excerpt: He coming in and he could just be plug and play.
quotes.quote: He coming in and he could just be plug and play, whatever you need me to do in this situation. He wants stretch fours and fives, bigs that can shoot, bigs that can protect the rim, bigs that can catch lobs, shooters. He's the greatest shooter ever in the game on your team.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero on LeBron James' ability to position teammates
quotes.excerpt: LeBron come in, it changes because he's so great at putting everybody in the right positions.
quotes.quote: LeBron come in, it changes because he's so great at putting everybody in the right positions and he still a scoring threat. And he still a scoring threat. Like don't get me wrong, part of me is very, I'm going to be very selfish. I want LeBron and Steph to be on opposite ends. Like for me, because that defined the era of basketball that I was covering and watching, the two great Titans.
